scenario.summary: Threat actor REF3364 targets Linux GPU hosts by exploiting unauthenticated Ray job agents to gain root access and persistent shell control. The campaign deploys the SANSAR toolkit, which employs a kernel rootkit to hide its presence and modified NVIDIA libraries to falsify GPU utilization while managing cryptomining and backdoors via Tor and Ethereum-based infrastructure.

hunt.name: SANSAR Stealth and Evasive C2 Channels
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the stealth mechanisms and evasive Command and Control channels of the SANSAR toolkit. It targets the installation of the acpi_thermal_mgr kernel module and the libnvidia-ml library hook used to falsify GPU telemetry. The flow correlates these stealth indicators with behavioral patterns such as specific GPU inventory queries and the use of external IP discovery services that precede Tor-based C2 communication.

nodes.label: Detect rootkit and library hook indicators

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%acpi_thermal_mgr.ko%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%libnvidia-ml.so.1.backup%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts with the SANSAR kernel module or the modified NVML library backup file.
config.expected_signal: Rows indicating the presence of the toolkit files. Silence suggests these specific names were not used or are hidden by a functional rootkit.

nodes.label: DNS lookups to IP discovery services

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as count FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{ip_check_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Identify the sequence of IP discovery attempts SANSAR uses to bootstrap its Tor connection.
config.expected_signal: DNS queries to multiple services from the list on a single host.
